data.title: 塑心 · 唱片的前奏
data.description: 前奏刚响起，她便闭上眼听了一会儿。曲子结束后，她把唱片封套翻过来寻找演奏者的名字。
data.camera: 中景，唱片架与耳机同框
data.promptProse: Virtuosa stands beside a turntable listening booth in a vintage record shop, wearing cushioned leather headphones while gently holding a classical album sleeve in both hands. Rows of wooden vinyl crates and soft incandescent bulb light surround her as she tilts her head, savoring the subtle acoustic overture.
data.animaCaption: With headphones resting over her ears, she closes her eyes to absorb the record's prelude, her fingertips tracing the edges of the illustrated vinyl sleeve.
